Before the 9th century Lavo was one of the supra-regional centres of the mandala-style polities of Dvaravati, with Si Thep, Sema, Phimai and Nakhon Pathom. Climate change and invasion from neighbouring polities reduced several of those centres, and the mandalas of the Menam valley then fell into three groups. Lavo (modern Lopburi) lay to the east, in closer contact with the Angkorian and pre-Angkorian worlds; Suphannaphum (modern Suphanburi) to the west, in closer contact with the Mon and Malay worlds; and the northern polities, more mixed than either in culture, ethnicity and language. Meanwhile, the Mun–Chi mandalas allied with Kambujadesa in the Tonlé Sap basin.

Lazica.headline: Lazika
paragraphs: Kraljestvo Lazika (gruzijsko: ეგრისი; lazijsko: ლაზიკა; starogrško: Λαζική), včasih imenovano Lazijsko cesarstvo, je bilo država na ozemlju zahodne Gruzije v rimskem obdobju, od približno 1. stoletja pr. n. št. Nastalo je, ko je razpadlo kraljestvo Kolhida in so plemenske ozemeljske enote v njem leta 131 n. št. dosegle neodvisnost.
notes: Izpuščene so latinične transliteracije gruzijskega, lazijskega in grškega imena.
Drugi stavek vira nima glavnega glagola; dopolnjen je po smislu. Vir postavlja začetek države v 1. stoletje pr. n. št., njeno nastanje pa v leto 131 n. št.; prevedeno je, kot stoji.

source.title: Lazica
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Lazica (Georgian: ეგრისი, romanized: Egrisi; Laz: ლაზიკა, romanized: Laziǩa; Ancient Greek: Λαζική, romanized: Lazikḗ), sometimes called Lazian Empire, was a state in the territory of west Georgia in the Roman period, from about the 1st century BC. Created as a result of the collapse of the kingdom of Colchis and the gaining of independence by the tribal-territorial units included in it in 131 AD.

Lê dynasty.headline: Dinastija Lê
paragraphs: Dinastija Lê, v zgodovinopisju znana tudi kot pozna dinastija Lê (vietnamsko: Nhà Hậu Lê ali Triều Hậu Lê; chữ Hán: 朝後黎; chữ Nôm: 茹後黎), je bila najdlje vladajoča vietnamska dinastija, ki je Đại Việtu (chữ Hán: 大越) vladala od leta 1428 do 1789, s prekinitvijo med letoma 1527 in 1533. Dinastijo Lê delimo na dve zgodovinski obdobji: na začetno dinastijo Lê (vietnamsko: triều Lê sơ ali nhà Lê Sơ; chữ Hán: 朝黎初; chữ Nôm: 茹黎初; 1428–1527) pred uzurpacijo dinastije Mạc, ko so cesarji vladali sami, in na obnovljeno dinastijo Lê (vietnamsko: triều Lê Trung hưng ali nhà Lê Trung hưng; chữ Hán: 朝黎中興; chữ Nôm: 茹黎中興; 1533–1789), ko so cesarji vladali pod okriljem mogočne rodbine Trịnh. Obnovljeno dinastijo Lê sta zaznamovali dve dolgi državljanski vojni: vojna Lê–Mạc (1533–1592), v kateri sta se dve dinastiji bojevali za legitimnost v severnem Vietnamu, in vojne Trịnh–Nguyễn (1627–1672, 1774–1777) med gospodi Trịnh na severu in gospodi Nguyễn na jugu.

source.title: Lê dynasty
paragraphs: The Lê dynasty, also known in historiography as the Later Lê dynasty (Vietnamese: Nhà Hậu Lê or Triều Hậu Lê, chữ Hán: 朝後黎, chữ Nôm: 茹後黎), was the longest-ruling Vietnamese dynasty, having ruled Đại Việt (chữ Hán: 大越) from 1428 to 1789 with an interregnum between 1527 and 1533. The Lê dynasty is divided into two historical periods: the Initial Lê dynasty (Vietnamese: triều Lê sơ or nhà Lê Sơ, chữ Hán: 朝黎初, chữ Nôm: 茹黎初; 1428–1527) before the usurpation by the Mạc dynasty, in which emperors ruled in their own right, and the Revival Lê dynasty (Vietnamese: triều Lê Trung hưng or nhà Lê Trung hưng, chữ Hán: 朝黎中興, chữ Nôm: 茹黎中興; 1533–1789), in which the emperors were figures who reigned under the auspices of the powerful Trịnh family. The Revival Lê dynasty was marked by two lengthy civil wars: the Lê–Mạc War (1533–1592) in which two dynasties battled for legitimacy in northern Vietnam and the Trịnh–Nguyễn Wars (1627–1672, 1774–1777) between the Trịnh lords in North and the Nguyễn lords of the South.

Lodi dynasty.headline: Dinastija Lodi
paragraphs: Dinastija Lodi je od leta 1451 do 1526 vladala Delhijskemu sultanatu. Bila je peta in zadnja dinastija Delhijskega sultanata s tremi vladarji na prestolu, ustanovil pa jo je Bahlul Lodi, ko je zamenjal dinastijo Sajid.

source.title: Lodi dynasty
paragraphs: The Lodi dynasty was a dynasty that ruled the Sultanate of Delhi from 1451 to 1526. It was the fifth and final dynasty of the Delhi Sultanate, with three rulers ascending to throne, and was founded by Bahlul Lodi when he replaced the Sayyid dynasty.

Lohara dynasty.headline: Dinastija Lohara
paragraphs: Dinastija Lohara je od leta 1003 do približno 1175 vladala Kašmirju in okoliškim območjem na severozahodu Indijske podceline. Zgodnjo zgodovino dinastije opisuje Radžatarangini (»Kronika kraljev«), delo, ki ga je sredi 12. stoletja napisal Kalhana in na katerem temelji veliko raziskav o prvih 150 letih dinastije. Poznejša poročila, ki segajo do konca dinastije in čez, sta zapisala Džonaradža in Šrivara. Poznejše vladarje dinastije so imeli za šibke. V tem obdobju so bili pogosti notranji spori in korupcija, ki so jih le občasno prekinila kratka obdobja stabilnosti. Ti dejavniki so dinastijo naredili ranljivo za širjenje islamskih osvajanj v regiji.

source.title: Lohara dynasty
paragraphs: The Lohara dynasty was a dynasty that ruled over Kashmir and surrounding regions in the northwestern part of the Indian subcontinent between 1003 and approximately 1175. The early history of the dynasty was described in the Rajatarangini (Chronicle of Kings), a work written by Kalhana in the mid-12th century, upon which many studies of the first 150 years of the dynasty depend. Subsequent accounts which provide information up to and beyond the end of the dynasty come from Jonarāja and Śrīvara. The later rulers of the dynasty were perceived as weak. Internal conflicts and instances of corruption were prevalent during this era, occasionally interrupted by short periods of stability. These factors contributed to the dynasty's susceptibility to the expansion of Islamic conquests in the region.
Mahadžanapade so bile šestnajst kraljestev in aristokratskih republik, ki so v stari Indiji obstajale od 6. do 4. stoletja pr. n. št., v obdobju druge urbanizacije.

source.title: Mahajanapadas
paragraphs: The Mahājanapadas were sixteen kingdoms and aristocratic republics that existed in ancient India from the sixth to fourth centuries BCE, during the second urbanisation period.

Dinastija Mahameghavahana (IAST: Mahā-Mēgha-Vāhana; od 2. ali 1. stoletja pr. n. št. do začetka 4. stoletja n. št.) je bila starodavna vladajoča dinastija Kalinge po zatonu Maurijskega imperija. V 1. stoletju pr. n. št. je osvojila Kalingo in Kosalo. Med vladavino Kharavele, tretjega kralja dinastije, je Južna Kosala postala sestavni del kraljestva. Kharavela je podpiral džainizem, vendar ni zapostavljal drugih ver. Znan je po napisu v Hathigumphi.

Južno Kosalo je v začetku 2. stoletja n. št. osvojil Gautamiputra Satakarni iz dinastije Satavahana in je ostala v njeni posesti do druge polovice 2. stoletja n. št. V 2. in 3. stoletju n. št. so se Meghe ali Meghavahane vrnili na politično prizorišče in znova pridobili nadoblast nad Južno Kosalo. Samudragupta je na pohodu v Dakšinapatho porazil Mahendro iz Dakšina Kosale, ki je po neki domnevi verjetno pripadal dinastiji Megha. Južna Kosala je zato v 4. stoletju n. št. postala del Guptskega imperija.
notes: Drugi stavek vira nima osebka; dopolnjen je po smislu (dinastija).

source.title: Mahameghavahana dynasty
paragraphs: The Mahameghavahana dynasty (IAST: Mahā-Mēgha-Vāhana) 2nd or 1st century BC to early 4th century CE) was an ancient ruling dynasty of Kalinga after the decline of the Maurya Empire. In the first century B.C. conquered Kalinga and Kosala. During the reign of Kharavela, the third king of Mahameghavahana dynasty, South Kosala became an integral part of the kingdom. He patronised Jainism, but did not discriminate against other religions. He is known by his Hathigumpha inscription.

South Kosala was later conquered by Gautamiputra Satakarni of the Satavahana dynasty in the early part of the 2nd century CE and remained in their possession up to the second half of the 2nd century CE. It was during the second and third century CE, the Meghas or Meghavahanas reappeared in the political scene and regained their suzerainty over South Kosala. Samudragupta during his Dakshinapatha expedition, defeated Mahendra of Dakshina Kosala who probably belonged to the Megha dynasty according to a speculation. As a result, the South Kosala during the fourth century A.D, became a part of the Gupta empire.

Maitraka dynasty.headline: Dinastija Maitraka
paragraphs: Dinastija Maitraka je približno od leta 475 do 776 iz prestolnice Valabhi vladala kraljestvu Valabhi v zahodni Indiji. Razen Dharapatte (petega kralja dinastije), ki ga povezujejo s čaščenjem sonca, so bili privrženci šivaizma.

source.title: Maitraka dynasty
paragraphs: The Maitraka dynasty ruled the Kingdom of Valabhi in western India from approximately 475 to 776 from their capital at Vallabhi. With the sole exception of Dharapaṭṭa (the fifth king in the dynasty), who is associated with sun-worship, they were followers of Shaivism.

Marathski imperij, imenovan tudi Marathska konfederacija, je bil zgodnjenovoveška državna tvorba na Indijski podcelini. Večino časa so ga sestavljali posesti pešve in štiri večje neodvisne marathske države pod nominalnim vodstvom pešve in v nominalni zvestobi čatrapatijem, Šivadžijevim naslednikom.

source.title: Maratha Empire
paragraphs: The Maratha Empire, also referred to as the Maratha Confederacy, was an early modern polity in the Indian subcontinent. For most of its existence, it comprised the realms of the Peshwa and four major independent Maratha states under the nominal leadership of the former and nominal loyalty to the Chhatrapatis who were successors of Shivaji.

Maukhari dynasty.headline: Dinastija Maukhari
paragraphs: Dinastija Maukhari (guptska pisava: Mau-kha-ri) je bila poguptska dinastija, ki je skoraj stoletje iz Kannaudža nadzorovala obsežne ravnice med Gango in Jamuno. Najprej so bili Maukhariji vazali Gupt, pozneje pa Harševe dinastije Vardhana. Neodvisnost so si izborili sredi 6. stoletja. Dinastija je vladala velikemu delu Utar Pradeša in Magadhe. Okoli leta 606 n. št. so velik del njihovega ozemlja znova osvojili pozni Gupte. Po Šuanzangu je ozemlje morda prešlo v roke kralja Šašanke iz kraljestva Gauda, ki je okoli leta 600 razglasil neodvisnost.
notes: V viru manjka znak v guptski pisavi; ohranjena je le transliteracija.

source.title: Maukharis of Kannauj
paragraphs: The Maukhari dynasty (Gupta script:, Mau-kha-ri) was a post-Gupta dynasty who controlled the vast plains of Ganga-Yamuna for almost a century from Kannauj. They earlier served as vassals of the Guptas and later of Harsha's Vardhana dynasty. The Maukharis established their independence during the mid-6th century. The dynasty ruled over much of Uttar Pradesh and Magadha. Around 606 CE, a large area of their empire was reconquered by the Later Guptas. According to Xuanzang, the territory may have been lost to King Shashanka of the Gauda Kingdom, who declared independence circa 600CE.

Maurijski imperij je bil geografsko obsežna zgodovinska sila železne dobe v Južni Aziji s središčem moči v Magadhi. Ustanovil ga je Čandragupta Maurja okoli leta 320 pr. n. št., v ohlapni obliki pa je obstajal do leta 185 pr. n. št. Glavni pisni viri za maurijsko obdobje so delni zapisi iz izgubljene Megastenove zgodovine v rimskih besedilih nekaj stoletij pozneje in Ašokovi edikti. Arheološko sodi obdobje maurijske vladavine v Južni Aziji v obdobje severne črne polirane keramike (NBPW).

source.title: Maurya Empire
paragraphs: The Maurya Empire was a geographically extensive Iron Age historical power in South Asia with its power base in Magadha. Founded by Chandragupta Maurya around c. 320 BCE, it existed in loose-knit fashion until 185 BCE. The primary sources for the written records of the Mauryan times are partial records of the lost history of Megasthenes in Roman texts of several centuries later, and the Edicts of Ashoka. Archaeologically, the period of Mauryan rule in South Asia falls into the era of Northern Black Polished Ware (NBPW).

Moghulistan.headline: Mogulistan
paragraphs: Mogulistan, imenovan tudi Mogulski kanat ali Vzhodni čagatajski kanat, je bil turško-mongolski muslimanski kanat, ki se je odcepil od Čagatajskega kanata, in zgodovinsko geografsko območje severno od gorovja Tengri Tag na meji med Srednjo in Vzhodno Azijo. Območje danes obsega dele Kazahstana, Kirgizistana in severozahodnega Šinjianga. Kanat je temu območju nominalno vladal od sredine 14. do konca 17. stoletja.

Od sredine 14. stoletja je v porečju reke Ili nastal nov kanat v obliki nomadske plemenske konfederacije, ki jo je vodil član Čagatajeve rodbine. Zato velja za nadaljevanje Čagatajskega kanata, imenujejo pa ga tudi Mogulski kanat.

source.title: Moghulistan
paragraphs: Moghulistan, also called the Moghul Khanate or the Eastern Chagatai Khanate, was a Turco-Mongol, Muslim, breakaway khanate of the Chagatai Khanate and a historical geographic area north of the Tengri Tagh mountain range, on the border of Central Asia and East Asia. That area today includes parts of Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, and northwest Xinjiang. The khanate nominally ruled over the area from the mid-14th century until the late 17th century.

Beginning in the mid-14th century a new khanate, in the form of a nomadic tribal confederacy headed by a member of the family of Chagatai, arose in the region of the Ili River. It is therefore considered to be a continuation of the Chagatai Khanate, but it is also referred to as the Moghul Khanate.

Mongol invasion of Central Asia.headline: Mongolski pohodi v Srednji Aziji
paragraphs: Mongolsko cesarstvo je po združitvi mongolskih in turških plemen na Mongolski planoti leta 1206 izvedlo več pohodov v Srednji Aziji. Med manjše vojaške operacije sodita uničenje preživelih Merkitov in Najmanov (ki je vključevalo vpade v Kumanijo) in osvojitev Kara Kitaja. Sledil je velik pohod proti Horezmu. Širjenje v Srednjo Azijo se je začelo leta 1209, ko je Džingis-kan poslal odpravo, da bi zasledovala tekmece, ki so pobegnili v to območje in ogrožali njegovo novo cesarstvo. Ujgursko kraljestvo Kočo in voditelji Karlukov so se Mongolskemu cesarstvu podredili prostovoljno in se poročili v cesarsko družino. Do leta 1218 so Mongoli nadzorovali ves Šinjiang, do leta 1221 pa vsa ozemlja nekdanjega Horezmijskega cesarstva. Leta 1236 so Mongoli porazili vzhodne dele Kumanije in vdrli v vzhodno Evropo.
notes: Naslov »Mongol invasion of Central Asia« preusmeri na članek »Mongol campaigns in Central Asia«.

source.title: Mongol campaigns in Central Asia
paragraphs: The Mongol Empire conducted several campaigns in Central Asia after the unification of the Mongol and Turkic tribes on the Mongolian Plateau in 1206. Smaller military operations included the destruction of surviving Merkit and Naimans (which involved forays into Cumania) and the conquest of Qara Khitai. These were followed by a major campaign against Khwarazm. Expansion into Central Asia began in 1209 as Genghis Khan sent an expedition to pursue rivals who had fled to the region and threatened his new empire. The Uyghur kingdom Qocho and leaders of the Karluks submitted voluntarily to the Mongol Empire and married into the imperial family. By 1218 the Mongols controlled all of Xinjiang and by 1221 all the territories of the former Khwarazmian Empire. In 1236, the Mongols defeated the eastern portions of Cumania and swept into Eastern Europe.
Izraz mongolski kanat se lahko nanaša na:
kanat Hamag Mongol (10. stoletje–1206),
Mongolsko cesarstvo (1206–1368).
notes: Zapis je povezan z razločitveno stranjo; prevedeno je kot seznam, kot stoji.

source.title: Mongol khanate
paragraphs: Mongol khanate or Mongolian khanate can refer to:
Khanate of the Khamag Mongol (10th century–1206)
Mongol Empire (1206-1368)

Myinsaing Kingdom.headline: Kraljestvo Mjinsaing
paragraphs: Kraljestvo Mjinsaing (burmansko: မြင်စိုင်းခေတ်) je bilo kraljestvo, ki je od leta 1297 do 1313 vladalo osrednji Burmi (Mjanmaru). Ustanovili so ga trije bratje iz Mjinsainga, Athinkhaja, Jazathingjan in Thihathu, in je bilo eno od številnih malih kraljestev, ki so nastala po propadu Paganskega cesarstva leta 1287. Mjinsaing je v letih 1300–1301 uspešno odbil drugo mongolsko invazijo in nato združil osrednjo Burmo od Tagaunga na severu do Proma (Pjaja) na jugu. Skupno vladanje bratov se je končalo med letoma 1310 in 1313 s smrtjo starejših bratov Athinkhaje in Jazathingjana. Leta 1315 je osrednja burmanska država razpadla na tekmeci državi Pinja in Sagaing. Osrednja Burma se je znova združila šele z vzponom Ave pet desetletij pozneje.
notes: Izpuščena je izgovarjava (IPA).

source.title: Myinsaing Kingdom
paragraphs: The Myinsaing Kingdom (Burmese: မြင်စိုင်းခေတ် [mjɪ̀ɰ̃záɪɰ̃ kʰɪʔ]) was the kingdom that ruled central Burma (Myanmar) from 1297 to 1313. It was founded by three brothers—Athinkhaya, Yazathingyan and Thihathu from Myinsaing— and was one of many small kingdoms that emerged following the collapse of the Pagan Empire in 1287. Myinsaing successfully fended off the second Mongol invasion in 1300–1301, and went on to unify central Burma from Tagaung in the north to Prome (Pyay) in the south. The brothers' co-rule ended between 1310 and 1313, with the death of the two elder brothers Athinkhaya and Yazathingyan. In 1315, the central Burmese state split into two rival states of Pinya and Sagaing. Central Burma would not be reunified until the rise of Ava five decades later.

Imperij Nanda je bil obsežen imperij, ki je v 4. stoletju pr. n. št. vladal Magadhi in Gangeški nižini z velikim geografskim obsegom na severovzhodu Indije, po nekaterih poročilih pa je obstajal že v 5. stoletju pr. n. št. Nande so nadgradili uspehe svojih predhodnikov iz dinastij Harjanka in Šišunaga in uvedli bolj centralizirano upravo. Stari viri jim pripisujejo veliko bogastvo, ki je bilo verjetno posledica uvedbe novega denarnega in davčnega sistema.

Stara besedila nakazujejo tudi, da so bili Nande med podložniki nepriljubljeni zaradi nizkega rodu, pretiranih davkov in splošno slabega ravnanja. Zadnjega kralja Nande Dhano Nando je strmoglavil Čandragupta Maurja, ustanovitelj Maurijskega imperija.

source.title: Nanda Empire
paragraphs: The Nanda Empire was a vast empire that governed in Magadha and Gangetic plains with an enormous geographical reach in 4th-century BCE northeastern India, with some accounts suggesting existence as far back as the 5th century BCE. The Nandas built on the successes of their Haryanka and Shaishunaga predecessors and installed a more centralised administration. Ancient sources credit them with amassing great wealth, which was probably the result of the introduction of a new currency and taxation system.

Ancient texts also suggest that the Nandas were unpopular among their subjects because of their low-status birth, excessive taxation, and general misconduct. The last Nanda king Dhana Nanda was overthrown by Chandragupta Maurya, founder of the Maurya Empire.

Nanyue.headline: Nanjue
paragraphs: Nanjue (kitajsko: 南越 ali 南粵; dobesedno »južni Jue«; vietnamsko: Nam Việt; džuangško: Namz Yied) je bilo starodavno kraljestvo, ki ga je leta 204 pr. n. št. ustanovil kitajski general Džao Tuo, njegova rodbina (v vietnamščini znana kot dinastija Triệu) pa mu je vladala do leta 111 pr. n. št. Nanjue je obsegal današnje kitajske upravne enote Guangdong, Guangši, Hajnan, Hongkong, Macao in južni Fudžjan ter osrednji in severni Vietnam. Džao Tuo, tedaj poveljnik poveljništva Nanhaj dinastije Čin, je Nanjue ustanovil leta 204 pr. n. št. po propadu dinastije Čin. Sprva so ga sestavljala poveljništva Nanhaj, Guilin in Šjang.
notes: Izpuščena sta zapisa v pinjinu in jutpingu.

source.title: Nanyue
paragraphs: Nanyue (Chinese: 南越 or 南粵; pinyin: Nányuè; Jyutping: Naam4 Jyut6; lit. 'Southern Yue', Vietnamese: Nam Việt, Zhuang: Namz Yied) was an ancient kingdom founded in 204 BC by the Chinese general Zhao Tuo, whose family (known in Vietnamese as the Triệu dynasty) continued to rule until 111 BC. Nanyue's geographical expanse covered the modern Chinese subdivisions of Guangdong, Guangxi, Hainan, Hong Kong, Macau, southern Fujian and central to northern Vietnam. Zhao Tuo, then Commander of Nanhai Commandery of the Qin dynasty, established Nanyue in 204 BC after the collapse of the Qin dynasty. At first, it consisted of the commanderies of Nanhai, Guilin, and Xiang.

Kraljestvo Nandžao (poenostavljeno kitajsko: 南诏; tradicionalno kitajsko: 南詔), zapisano tudi Nančao (dobesedno »južni Džao«; jezik ji: ꂷꏂꌅ), je bilo dinastično kraljestvo, ki je v 8. in 9. stoletju, v sredini in poznem obdobju dinastije Tang, cvetelo na območju današnje jugozahodne Kitajske in severne Jugovzhodne Azije. Središče je imelo v današnjem Junanu na Kitajskem, prestolnice pa v današnjem mestu Dali. Uradno se je kraljestvo od leta 738 do 859 imenovalo Dameng (大蒙), od leta 859 do 877 Dali (大禮), od leta 877 do 902 pa Dafengmin (大封民).
notes: Izpuščena sta zapis v pinjinu in latinični zapis imena v jeziku ji (Mashynzy).

source.title: Nanzhao
paragraphs: Nanzhao (simplified Chinese: 南诏; traditional Chinese: 南詔; pinyin: Nánzhào), also spelled Nanchao (lit. 'Southern Zhao', Yi language: ꂷꏂꌅ, Mashynzy), was a dynastic kingdom that flourished in what is now southwestern China and northern Southeast Asia during the 8th and 9th centuries, during the mid/late Tang dynasty. It was centered on present-day Yunnan in China, with its capitals in modern-day Dali City. The kingdom was officially called Dameng (大蒙) from 738 to 859 AD, Dali (大禮) from 859 to 877 and Dafengmin (大封民) from 877 to 902.

Nawab of Awadh.headline: Navab Avadha
paragraphs: Navab Avadha ali navab Oudha je bil naslov vladarjev kraljestva Avadh (poangleženo Oudh) v severni Indiji v 18. in 19. stoletju. Avadski navabi so pripadali iranski dinastiji sajidskega porekla šiitske veroizpovedi iz Nišapurja v Iranu. Navab Saadat kan je leta 1724 ustanovil kraljestvo Avadh s prestolnicama v Faizabadu in Lakhnauju.

source.title: Nawab of Awadh
paragraphs: The Nawab of Awadh or Nawab of Oudh was the title of the rulers of Kingdom of Awadh (anglicised as Oudh) in northern India during the 18th and 19th centuries. The Nawabs of Awadh belonged to an Iranian dynasty of Sayyid origin of Shia Islam. from Nishapur, Iran. In 1724, Nawab Sa'adat Khan established the Kingdom of Awadh with their capital in Faizabad and Lucknow.

Nawabs of Bengal.headline: Bengalski navabi
paragraphs: Bengalski navabi so bili dedni vladarji subaha Bengal v mogulski Indiji. V začetku 18. stoletja je bil bengalski navab dejansko neodvisen vladar treh provinc, Bengala, Biharja in Orise, zato jih pogosto imenujejo navabi Bengala, Biharja in Orise. Navabi so imeli sedež v Muršidabadu, ki je ležal v osrčju Bengala, Biharja in Orise. Njihov poglavar, nekdanji predsednik vlade, je postal prvi navab. Navabi so še naprej kovali denar v imenu mogulskega cesarja, dejansko pa so vladali kot neodvisni monarhi. Bengal je še vedno prispeval največji delež sredstev v cesarsko mogulsko zakladnico v Delhiju.
Subah Bengal je vrhunec dosegel med vladavino navaba Šudža ud-Dina Mohameda kana.
Navabi, zlasti v 16-letni vladavini Alivardija kana, so se zapletli v številne vojne z Marathi. Proti koncu se je Alivardi posvetil obnovi Bengala.

source.title: Nawabs of Bengal
paragraphs: The nawabs of Bengal were the hereditary rulers of Bengal Subah in Mughal India. In the early 18th century, the Nawab of Bengal was the de facto independent ruler of the three provinces of Bengal, Bihar and Orissa and they are often referred to as the nawabs of Bengal, Bihar and Orissa. The nawabs were based in Murshidabad which was centrally located within Bengal, Bihar, and Orissa. Their chief, a former prime minister, became the first nawab. The nawabs continued to issue coins in the name of the Mughal emperor, but for all practical purposes, the nawabs governed as independent monarchs. Bengal continued to contribute the largest share of funds to the imperial Mughal treasury in Delhi.
The Bengal Subah reached its peak during the reign of Nawab Shuja-ud-Din Muhammad Khan.

The nawabs, especially under the rule of Alivardi Khan of 16 years, were heavily engaged in various wars against the Marathas. Towards the end, he turned his attention to rebuilding and restoring Bengal.

Ngô dynasty.headline: Dinastija Ngô
paragraphs: Dinastija Ngô (vietnamsko: Nhà Ngô; chữ Nôm: 茹吳), uradno Tĩnh Hải quân (chữ Hán: 靜海軍), je bila polneodvisna vietnamska dinastija od leta 939 do 968. Ustanovil jo je Ngô Quyền, ki je leta 938 vodil vietnamske sile v bitki na reki Bạch Đằng proti kitajski dinastiji Južni Han.

source.title: Ngô dynasty
paragraphs: The Ngô dynasty (Vietnamese: Nhà Ngô; Chữ Nôm: 茹吳), officially Tĩnh Hải quân (chữ Hán: 靜海軍), was a semi-independent Vietnamese dynasty from 939 to 968. The dynasty was founded by Ngô Quyền, who led the Vietnamese forces in the Battle of Bạch Đằng River against the Chinese Southern Han dynasty in 938.

Nguyễn lords.headline: Gospodje Nguyễn
paragraphs: Gospodje Nguyễn (vietnamsko: Chúa Nguyễn; chữ Hán: 主阮; 1558–1777, 1780–1802), znani tudi kot klan Nguyễn (vietnamsko: Nguyễn thị; chữ Hán: 阮氏), so bili predhodniki dinastije Nguyễn in fevdalni plemiški klan, ki je v času obnovljene dinastije Lê vladal južnemu Đại Việtu. Gospodje Nguyễn so bili člani rodbine Nguyễn Phúc. Ozemlje, ki so mu vladali, so tedaj imenovali Đàng Trong (notranje kraljestvo), z eksonimi pa kraljestvo Kočinčina in kraljestvo Quảng Nam (vietnamsko: Quảng Nam Quốc; chữ Hán: 廣南國), v nasprotju z gospodi Trịnh, ki so severnemu Đại Việtu vladali kot Đàng Ngoài (zunanje kraljestvo), ki so ga Evropejci imenovali »kraljestvo Tonkin«, cesarska Kitajska pa v dvostranski diplomaciji »kraljestvo An Nam« (vietnamsko: An Nam Quốc; chữ Hán: 安南國). Uradni naslov Nguyễn Vương (chữ Hán: 阮王) so dobili leta 1744, ko se je gospod Nguyễn Phúc Khoát sam razglasil zanj, da bi se položajno izenačil z naslovom gospodov Trịnh, Trịnh Vương (vietnamsko: Trịnh Vương; chữ Hán: 鄭王). Klana Nguyễn in Trịnh sta bila de iure podrejena in fevda dinastije Lê. De iure podrejenost gospodov Nguyễn gospodom Trịnh se je končala leta 1627 in sprožila vojno med njima.

source.title: Nguyễn lords
paragraphs: The Nguyễn lords (Vietnamese: Chúa Nguyễn, chữ Hán: 主阮; 1558–1777, 1780–1802), also known as the Nguyễn clan (Vietnamese: Nguyễn thị; chữ Hán: 阮氏), were Nguyễn dynasty's forerunner and a feudal noble clan ruling southern Đại Việt in the Revival Lê dynasty. The Nguyễn lords were members of the House of Nguyễn Phúc. The territory they ruled was known contemporarily as Đàng Trong (Inner Realm) and by the exonyms the Kingdom of Cochinchina and the Kingdom of Quảng Nam (Vietnamese: Quảng Nam Quốc; chữ Hán: 廣南國), in opposition to the Trịnh lords, who ruled northern Đại Việt as Đàng Ngoài (Outer Realm), known as the "Kingdom of Tonkin" by Europeans and "Kingdom of An Nam" (Vietnamese: An Nam Quốc; chữ Hán: 安南國) by Imperial China in bilateral diplomacy. They were officially entitled, in Sino-Vietnamese, the Nguyễn Vương (chữ Hán: 阮王) in 1744 when lord Nguyễn Phúc Khoát self-proclaimed himself to elevate his status equally to Trịnh lords's title known as the Trịnh Vương (Vietnamese: Trịnh Vương; chữ Hán: 鄭王). Both Nguyễn and Trịnh clans were de jure subordinates and fief of the Lê dynasty. However, the de jure submission of the Nguyễn lords to the Trịnh lords ended in 1627 sparked the war between them.

Severni Juan je bil dinastična država, ki ji je vladal mongolski klan Bordžigin s središčem na Mongolski planoti. Obstajal je kot okrnjena država po propadu dinastije Juan leta 1368 in trajal do leta 1635, ko ga je osvojila pozna dinastija Džin pod vodstvom Džurčenov, pozneje preimenovana v dinastijo Čing. Dinastija Severni Juan se je začela z umikom juanskega cesarskega dvora pod vodstvom Togona Temürja (cesarja Huejcunga iz dinastije Juan) v mongolsko stepo. Obdobje so zaznamovali boji med frakcijami in pogosto le nominalna vloga velikega kana.

source.title: Northern Yuan
paragraphs: The Northern Yuan was a dynastic state ruled by the Mongol Borjigin clan based in the Mongolian Plateau. It existed as a rump state after the collapse of the Yuan dynasty in 1368 and lasted until its conquest by the Jurchen-led Later Jin dynasty in 1635, which was later renamed as the Qing dynasty. The Northern Yuan dynasty began with the retreat of the Yuan imperial court led by Toghon Temür (Emperor Huizong of Yuan) to the Mongolian steppe. This period featured factional struggles and the often only nominal role of the Great Khan.

Oghuz Khagan.headline: Oguz kagan
paragraphs: Oguz kagan ali Oguz kan (turško: Oğuz Kağan ali Oğuz Han; azerbajdžansko: Oğuz Xan ali Oğuz Xaqan; turkmensko: Oguz Han) je legendarni kan turških ljudstev in eponimni prednik oguških Turkov. Nekatere turške kulture z legendo o Oguz kanu opisujejo svoj etnični in plemenski izvor. Različice pripovedi, ohranjene v številnih rokopisih, so izšle v mnogih jezikih. Pripovedi o njem pogosto nosijo naslov Oguzname; obstaja več izročil, ki opisujejo njegove številne podvige in osvajanja, nekatera pa se prekrivajo z drugimi turškimi epskimi izročili, kot sta Seldžukname in Knjiga Dede Korkuta. Oguz kan je izhajal iz plemena Balga, bil je sin Kara Beja (Oguz Beja) in je pozneje postal kan.
notes: Izpuščena je napotitev na seznam virov (»as listed in the references below«).

source.title: Oghuz Khagan
paragraphs: Oghuz Khagan or Oğuz Khan (Turkish: Oğuz Kağan or Oğuz Han; Azerbaijani: Oğuz Xan or Oğuz Xaqan; Turkmen: Oguz Han) is a legendary khan of the Turkic people and an eponymous ancestor of the Oghuz Turks. Some Turkic cultures use the legend of Oghuz Khan to describe their ethnic and tribal origins. The various versions of the narrative preserved in many different manuscripts have been published in numerous languages, as listed in the references below. The narratives about him are often entitled Oghuzname, of which there are several traditions describing his many feats and conquests; some of these tend to overlap with other Turkic epic traditions, such as the Seljukname and The Book of Dede Korkut. Oğuz Khan was from the Balga tribe, the son of Qara Bey (Oğuz Bey), and later became a khan.

Oirat Confederation.headline: Ojratska konfederacija
paragraphs: Ojratska konfederacija ali Štirje Ojrati (pisna ojratščina: ᡑᡈᠷᡋᡈᠨᡆᡕᡅᠷᠠᡑ; mongolsko: Дөрвөн Ойрад; kitajsko: 四衛拉特), nekoč znana kot Elevti, je bila konfederacija ojratskih plemen, s katero so se v zgodovini Mongolske planote povzpeli zahodni Mongoli.

Čeprav vzhodni Mongoli in Ojrati izraz »Štirje Ojrati« splošno uporabljajo in so ga zgodovinarji že večkrat razlagali, o tem, katera so bila prvotna štiri plemena, ni soglasja. Splošno velja, da izraz označuje plemena Čoros, Torgut, Dörbet in Hošut, po eni od teorij pa Ojrati niso bili krvno sorodne enote, temveč politično-etnične enote iz številnih rodov po moški liniji. V zgodnjem obdobju je konfederaciji pripadalo tudi pleme Kergüd.
notes: Izpuščeni so latinični zapisi ojratskega in mongolskega imena ter izgovarjava (IPA).

source.title: Oirat Confederation
paragraphs: The Four Oirats (Written Oirat: ᡑᡈᠷᡋᡈᠨᡆᡕᡅᠷᠠᡑ, Dörbön Oyirad; Mongolian: Дөрвөн Ойрад, romanized: Dörvön Oirad, pronounced [ˈtɵrw̜ʊ̈ɴ ˈɞe̯ɾ(ə)t]; Chinese: 四衛拉特) or Oirat Confederation, formerly known as the Eleuths, was the confederation of the Oirat tribes which marked the rise of the Western Mongols in the history of the Mongolian Plateau.

Despite the universal currency of the term "Four Oirat" among Eastern Mongols, Oirats, and numerous explanations by historians, no consensus has been reached on the identity of the original four tribes. While it is believed that the term Four Oirats refers to the Choros, Torghut, Dörbet, and Khoshut tribes, there is a theory that the Oirats were not consanguineous units, but political-ethnic units composed of many patrilineages. In the early period, the Kergüd tribe also belonged to the confederation.

Ottoman–Persian War (1730–1735).headline: Osmansko-perzijska vojna (1730–1735)
paragraphs: Osmansko-perzijska vojna 1730–1735 je bila spopad med silami safavidskega Irana in Osmanskega cesarstva v letih 1730–1735. Ko osmanska podpora ni uspela obdržati gilzajskih afganistanskih zavojevalcev na iranskem prestolu, so bile osmanske posesti v zahodnem Iranu, ki jim jih je podelila dinastija Hotaki, v nevarnosti, da jih znova priključi obnovljeno Iransko cesarstvo. Nadarjeni safavidski general Nader je Osmanom postavil ultimat, naj se umaknejo, a so ga ti prezrli. Sledila je vrsta pohodov, v katerih je v pol desetletja burnih dogodkov zdaj ena zdaj druga stran dobivala premoč. Iranska zmaga pri Jeghevardu je Osmane nazadnje prisilila, da so zaprosili za mir ter priznali ozemeljsko celovitost Irana in iransko prevlado na Kavkazu.

source.title: Ottoman–Persian War (1730–1735)
paragraphs: The Ottoman–Persian War of 1730–1735 was a conflict between the forces of Safavid Iran and those of the Ottoman Empire from 1730 to 1735. After Ottoman support had failed to keep the Ghilzai Afghan invaders on the Iranian throne, the Ottoman possessions in western Iran, which were granted to them by the Hotak dynasty, came under risk of re-incorporation into the newly resurgent Iranian Empire. The talented Safavid general, Nader, gave the Ottomans an ultimatum to withdraw, which the Ottomans chose to ignore. A series of campaigns followed, with each side gaining the upper hand in a succession of tumultuous events that spanned half a decade. Finally, the Iranian victory at Yeghevard made the Ottomans sue for peace and recognize Iranian territorial integrity and Iranian hegemony over the Caucasus.

Imperij Pala je bil zgodnjesrednjeveški indijski imperij, ki mu je vladala dinastija Pala (prakrtsko in sanskrtsko: पाल, dobesedno »zaščitnik«). Imperij je nastal, ko so poglavarji Gaude konec 8. stoletja n. št. izvolili Gopalo. Oporišče Pal je bilo v Bengalu in Biharju, kjer so ležala pomembna mesta Gauda, Vikramapura, Pataliputra, Monghir, Somapura, Ramavati (Varendra), Tamralipta in Džagadala.
notes: Izpuščena je latinična transliteracija.

source.title: Pala Empire
paragraphs: The Pāla Empire was an early medieval Indian empire ruled by the Pāla (Prakrit and Sanskrit: पाल, romanized: Pāla, lit. 'protector') dynasty. The empire was founded with the election of Gopāla by the chiefs of Gauda in the late 8th century CE. The Pala stronghold was located in Bengal and Bihar, which included the major cities of Gauḍa, Vikramapura, Pāṭaliputra, Monghyr, Somapura, Ramavati (Varendra), Tāmralipta and Jagaddala.

Dinastija Palava je od leta 275 do 897 vladala v južni Indiji, vključno z znatnim delom Dekana in Tondaimandalama. Uveljavila se je po padcu imperija Satavahana, ki mu je prej služila kot fevdalni podložnik.

Palave so postali velika južnoindijska sila v času vladanja Mahendravarmana I. (600–630) in Narasimhavarmana I. (630–668) in so približno šest stoletij, do konca 9. stoletja, obvladovali južno teluško pokrajino in severne dele tamilske pokrajine. Ves čas vladavine so bili v nenehnem sporu s Čalukjami iz Vatapija na severu ter s tamilskima kraljestvoma Čol in Pandj na jugu. Palave je v 9. stoletju dokončno porazil čolski vladar Aditja I.

source.title: Pallava dynasty
paragraphs: The Pallava dynasty ruled from 275 to 897 in southern India, including a significant portion of the Deccan and Tondaimandalam. The dynasty rose to prominence after the downfall of the Satavahana Empire, whom they had formerly served as feudatories.

The Pallavas became a major southern Indian power during the reign of Mahendravarman I (600–630) and Narasimhavarman I (630–668), and for about six centuries dominated the southern Telugu region and the northern parts of the Tamil region, until the end of the 9th century. Throughout their rule, they remained in constant conflict with both the Chalukyas of Vatapi to the north, and the Tamil kingdoms of Chola and Pandyas to their south. The Pallavas were finally defeated by the Chola ruler Aditya I in the 9th century.

Pandya Empire.headline: Imperij Pandja
paragraphs: Dinastija Pandja, imenovana tudi Pandje iz Maduraja, je bila starodavna tamilska dinastija južne Indije in eno od štirih velikih kraljestev Tamilakama, poleg Palav, Čol in Čer. Obstajala je vsaj od 4. ali 3. stoletja pr. n. št., dvakrat pa je imela imperialno prevlado: od 6. do 10. stoletja n. št. in pod »poznimi Pandjami« (od 13. do 14. stoletja n. št.). V drugi polovici 13. stoletja so Pandje pod Džatavarmanom Sundaro Pandjanom I. in Maravarmanom Kulasekaro Pandjanom I. vladali obsežnim ozemljem, vključno z deli današnje južne Indije in severne Šrilanke, prek vazalnih držav, podrejenih Maduraju. Dinastija Pandja velja za eno najdlje vladajočih dinastij na svetu, saj je bila neprekinjeno na oblasti približno od leta 400 pr. n. št. do 1618 n. št., čeprav sta se njen ozemeljski in upravni obseg močno spreminjala.
notes: Izpuščena je izgovarjava (IPA).

source.title: Pandya dynasty
paragraphs: The Pandya dynasty (Tamil: [paːɳɖijɐr]), also referred to as the Pandyas of Madurai, was an ancient Tamil dynasty of South India, and among the four great kingdoms of Tamilakam, the other three being the Pallavas, the Cholas and the Cheras. Existing since at least the 4th to 3rd centuries BCE, the dynasty passed through two periods of imperial dominance, the 6th to 10th centuries CE, and under the 'Later Pandyas' (13th to 14th centuries CE). In the second half of the 13th century under Jatavarman Sundara Pandyan I and Maravarman Kulasekara Pandyan I, the Pandyas ruled extensive territories including regions of present-day South India and northern Sri Lanka through vassal states subject to Madurai. The Pandya dynasty is considered to be one of the longest ruling dynasties in the world, in power continuously from roughly 400 BCE to 1618 CE, although its territorial and administrative extent varied significantly.

Paramara dynasty.headline: Dinastija Paramara
paragraphs: Dinastija Paramara (IAST: Paramāra) je bila indijska dinastija, ki je med letoma 948 in 1305 vladala Malvi in okoliškim območjem v zahodni osrednji Indiji. Pripadali so radžputskemu klanu Paramara.

Dinastija je nastala v 9. ali 10. stoletju, njeni zgodnji vladarji pa so najverjetneje vladali kot vazali Raštrakut iz Manjakhete. Najstarejše ohranjene napise Paramar, ki jih je izdal vladar Sijaka iz 10. stoletja, so našli v Gudžaratu. Okoli leta 972 je Sijaka oplenil raštrakutsko prestolnico Manjakheto in Paramare uveljavil kot suvereno silo. V času njegovega naslednika Mundže je pokrajina Malva v današnjem Madhja Pradešu postala osrednje ozemlje Paramar s prestolnico Dhara (danes Dhar). Na vrhuncu pod Bhodžo so vladali imperiju, ki je segal od Čitorja na severu do Konkana na jugu ter od reke Sabarmati na zahodu do Vidiše na vzhodu.

source.title: Paramara dynasty
paragraphs: The Paramara dynasty (IAST: Paramāra) was an Indian dynasty that ruled Malwa and surrounding areas in west-central India between 948 and 1305. They belonged to the Paramara clan of the Rajputs.

The dynasty was established in either the 9th or 10th century, and its early rulers most probably ruled as vassals of the Rashtrakutas of Manyakheta. The earliest extant Paramara inscriptions, issued by the 10th-century ruler Siyaka, have been found in Gujarat. Around 972, Siyaka sacked the Rashtrakuta capital Manyakheta, and established the Paramaras as a sovereign power. By the time of his successor Munja, the Malwa region in present-day Madhya Pradesh had become the core Paramara territory, with Dhara (now Dhar) as their capital. At its zenith under Bhoja, it ruled over an empire which extended from Chittor in the north to Konkan in the south, and from the Sabarmati River in the west to Vidisha in the east.

Ljudska republika Kampučija (LRK) je bila delno priznana država v Jugovzhodni Aziji, ki je obstajala od leta 1979 do 1992. Bila je satelitska država Vietnama, ki jo je v Kambodži ustanovila Kampučijska združena fronta za narodno rešitev, skupina kamboških komunistov, ki jih je Vietnam podpiral; nezadovoljni z zatiralsko vladavino Rdečih Kmerov so jih zapustili po strmoglavljenju Demokratične Kampučije, vlade Pol Pota. Država je nastala z vietnamsko invazijo, ki je razbila vojske Rdečih Kmerov, njeni glavni zaveznici pa sta bili Vietnam in Sovjetska zveza.

LRK zaradi diplomatskega posredovanja Kitajske, Združenega kraljestva, Združenih držav in držav ASEAN ni dobila priznanja Združenih narodov. Kamboški sedež v Združenih narodih je imela Koalicijska vlada Demokratične Kampučije, ki so jo sestavljali Rdeči Kmeri v koaliciji z dvema nekomunističnima gverilskima frakcijama. Kljub temu je LRK med letoma 1979 in 1992 veljala za dejansko vlado Kambodže, čeprav je bila zunaj sovjetskega bloka le omejeno mednarodno priznana.

source.title: People's Republic of Kampuchea
paragraphs: The People's Republic of Kampuchea (PRK) was a partially recognised state in Southeast Asia which existed from 1979 to 1992. It was a satellite state of Vietnam, founded in Cambodia by the Vietnamese-backed Kampuchean United Front for National Salvation, a group of Cambodian communists who were dissatisfied with the Khmer Rouge due to its oppressive rule and defected from it after the overthrow of Democratic Kampuchea, Pol Pot's government. Brought about by an invasion from Vietnam, which routed the Khmer Rouge armies, it had Vietnam and the Soviet Union as its main allies.

The PRK failed to secure United Nations endorsement due to the diplomatic intervention of China, the United Kingdom, the United States and the ASEAN countries. The Cambodian seat at the United Nations was held by the Coalition Government of Democratic Kampuchea, which was the Khmer Rouge in coalition with two non-communist guerrilla factions. However, the PRK was considered the de facto government of Cambodia between 1979 and 1992, albeit with limited international recognition outside of the Soviet Bloc.

Tretja perzijsko-turška vojna (627–629) je bila zadnji spopad med Sasanidskim cesarstvom in Zahodnim turškim kaganatom. V nasprotju s prejšnjima vojnama se ni bila v Srednji Aziji, temveč v Zakavkazju. Sovražnosti sta leta 627 začela Tong Jabgu kagan zahodnih Göktürkov in bizantinski cesar Heraklij. Nasproti so jima stali sasanidski Perzijci, zavezniki Avarov.

source.title: Perso-Turkic war of 627–629
paragraphs: The Perso-Turkic war of 627–629 was the final conflict between the Sasanian Empire and the Western Turkic Khaganate. Unlike the previous two wars, it was not fought in Central Asia, but in Transcaucasia. Hostilities were initiated in 627 by Tong Yabghu Qaghan of the Western Göktürks and Emperor Heraclius of the Byzantine Empire. Opposing them were the Sassanid Persians, allied with the Avars.

Pinya Kingdom.headline: Kraljestvo Pinja
paragraphs: Kraljestvo Pinja (burmansko: ပင်းယခေတ်) je bilo kraljestvo, ki je od leta 1313 do 1365 vladalo osrednjemu Mjanmaru (Burmi). Bilo je naslednik Mjinsainga, državne tvorbe, ki je med letoma 1297 in 1313 nadzorovala velik del Gornje Burme. Thihathu ga je ustanovil kot de iure naslednika Paganskega cesarstva, a je Pinjo že od začetka pestila notranja razklanost. Severna provinca Sagaing pod vodstvom Thihathujevega najstarejšega sina Saw Juna si je v letih 1315–1317 izborila avtonomijo in se leta 1325 po Thihathujevi smrti formalno odcepila.
notes: Izpuščena je izgovarjava (IPA).

source.title: Pinya kingdom
paragraphs: The Pinya kingdom (Burmese: ပင်းယခေတ်, pronounced [pɪ́ɰ̃ja̰ kʰɪʔ]) or Kingdom of Pinya was the kingdom that ruled Central Myanmar (Burma) from 1313 to 1365. It was the successor state of Myinsaing, the polity that controlled much of Upper Burma between 1297 and 1313. Founded as the de jure successor state of the Pagan empire by Thihathu, Pinya faced internal divisions from the start. The northern province of Sagaing led by Thihathu's eldest son Saw Yun successfully fought for autonomy in 1315−17, and formally seceded in 1325 after Thihathu's death.

Portuguese Ceylon.headline: Portugalski Cejlon
paragraphs: Portugalski Cejlon (portugalsko: Ceilão Português; sinhalsko: පෘතුගීසි ලංකාව; tamilsko: போர்த்துக்கேய இலங்கை), ozemlje na Cejlonu, današnji Šrilanki, je bil od leta 1597 do 1658 pod nadzorom Portugalskega imperija.

Portugalci so bili na otoku navzoči od leta 1505 do 1658. Prišli so tja večinoma po naključju in so hoteli nadzorovati trgovino, ne ozemlja. Pozneje so se ob političnih pretresih, znanih kot Vidžajaba Koljaja, vpletli v notranjo politiko otoka in te notranje razdore med sinhalsko-portugalskimi vojnami izkoristili sebi v prid, najprej da bi nadzorovali pridelavo dragocenega cimeta, pozneje pa ves otok. Neposredna portugalska oblast se je začela šele po smrti Dharmapale iz Kotteja, ki je umrl brez dediča in je leta 1580 kraljestvo Kotte zapustil portugalskemu monarhu. To je Portugalcem ob Dharmapalovi smrti leta 1597 dalo zadosten pravni naslov za kraljestvo Kotte. Portugalska oblast je že ob začetku naletela na močan odpor domačinov.

source.title: Portuguese Ceylon
paragraphs: Portuguese Ceylon (Portuguese: Ceilão Português; Sinhala: පෘතුගීසි ලංකාව; Tamil: போர்த்துக்கேய இலங்கை) was the territory on Ceylon, modern-day Sri Lanka, controlled by the Portuguese Empire between 1597 and 1658.

Portuguese presence in the island lasted from 1505 to 1658. Their arrival was largely accidental, and the Portuguese sought control of commerce, rather than territory. The Portuguese were later drawn into the internal politics of the island with the political upheaval of the Wijayaba Kollaya, and used these internal divisions to their advantage during the Sinhalese–Portuguese wars, first in an attempt to control the production of valuable cinnamon and later of the entire island. Direct Portuguese rule did not begin until after the death of Dharmapala of Kotte, who died without an heir, and had bequeathed the Kingdom of Kotte to the Portuguese monarch in 1580. That allowed the Portuguese sufficient claim to the Kingdom of Kotte upon Dharmapala's death in 1597. Portuguese rule began with much resistance by the local population.

Principality of Abkhazia.headline: Kneževina Abhazija
paragraphs: Kneževina Abhazija je nastala kot samostojna fevdalna tvorba v 15. in 16. stoletju sredi državljanskih vojn v Kraljestvu Gruziji, ki so se končale z razpadom enotne gruzijske monarhije. Kneževina je pod osmansko in nato rusko oblastjo ohranila nekaj avtonomije, vendar jo je Ruski imperij leta 1864 po kavkaški vojni dokončno priključil.

source.title: Principality of Abkhazia
paragraphs: The Principality of Abkhazia emerged as a separate feudal entity in the 15th–16th centuries, amid the civil wars in the Kingdom of Georgia that concluded with the dissolution of the unified Georgian monarchy. The principality retained a degree of autonomy under Ottoman and then Russian rule, but was eventually absorbed into the Russian Empire in 1864, following the Caucasian War.

Kneževina Gurija (gruzijsko: გურიის სამთავრო) je bila zgodovinska država v Gruziji. S središčem v današnji Guriji, jugozahodni gruzijski pokrajini, je ležala med Črnim morjem in Malim Kavkazom, od 1460. let do leta 1829 pa ji je vladalo dvaindvajset zaporednih knezov iz rodbine Gurieli. Kneževina je nastala med razpadanjem enotnega Kraljestva Gruzije. Njene meje so se spreminjale v nenehnih spopadih s sosednjimi gruzijskimi vladarji in Osmanskim cesarstvom, uživala pa je različno stopnjo avtonomije, dokler je leta 1829 ni priključila cesarska Rusija.
notes: Izpuščena je latinična transliteracija gruzijskega imena.

source.title: Principality of Guria
paragraphs: The Principality of Guria (Georgian: გურიის სამთავრო, romanized: guriis samtavro) was a historical state in Georgia. Centered on modern-day Guria, a southwestern region in Georgia, it was located between the Black Sea and Lesser Caucasus, and was ruled by a succession of twenty-two princes of the House of Gurieli from the 1460s to 1829. The principality emerged during the process of fragmentation of a unified Kingdom of Georgia. Its boundaries fluctuated in the course of permanent conflicts with neighboring Georgian rulers and the Ottoman Empire, and the principality enjoyed various degrees of autonomy until being annexed by Imperial Russia in 1829.

Iberska kneževina je bila zgodnjesrednjeveška aristokratska ureditev v osrednji gruzijski pokrajini Kartli, ki so jo antični avtorji imenovali Iberija. Razcvetela se je v obdobju medvladja med 6. in 9. stoletjem, ko so vodilno politično oblast izvajali zaporedni knezi. Kneževino so ustanovili kmalu po tem, ko so Sasanidi okoli leta 580 odpravili tamkajšnjo kraljevsko dinastijo Hosroidov; trajala je do leta 888, ko je član dinastije Bagrationi obnovil kraljevsko oblast. Njene meje so se močno spreminjale, saj so se iberski knezi v tem obdobju spopadali s Perzijci, Bizantinci, Hazari, Arabci in sosednjimi kavkaškimi vladarji.

source.title: Principality of Iberia
paragraphs: The Principality of Iberia was an early medieval aristocratic regime in a core Georgian region of Kartli, called Iberia by classical authors. It flourished in the period of interregnum between the sixth and ninth centuries, when the leading political authority was exercised by a succession of princes. The principality was established shortly after the Sassanid suppression of the local royal Chosroid dynasty, around 580; it lasted until 888, when the kingship was restored by a member of the Bagrationi dynasty. Its borders fluctuated greatly as the presiding princes of Iberia confronted the Persians, Byzantines, Khazars, Arabs, and neighboring Caucasian rulers throughout this period.
Kneževina Mingrelija (gruzijsko: სამეგრელოს სამთავრო), znana tudi kot Odiši in Samegrelo, je bila zgodovinska država v Gruziji, ki ji je vladala dinastija Dadiani.
notes: Izpuščena je latinična transliteracija gruzijskega imena.

source.title: Principality of Mingrelia
paragraphs: The Principality of Mingrelia (Georgian: სამეგრელოს სამთავრო, romanized: samegrelos samtavro), also known as Odishi and as Samegrelo, was a historical state in Georgia ruled by the Dadiani dynasty.

Kneževina Svaneti (gruzijsko: სვანეთის სამთავრო) je bila majhna kneževina (samtavro) v pokrajini Svaneti v gorovju Veliki Kavkaz, ki je nastala po razpadu Kraljestva Gruzije konec 15. stoletja. Zaporedoma sta ji vladali rodbini Gelovani in Dadeškeliani, leta 1858 pa so jo priključili Ruskemu imperiju.
notes: Izpuščena je latinična transliteracija gruzijskega imena.

source.title: Principality of Svaneti
paragraphs: The Principality of Svaneti (Georgian: სვანეთის სამთავრო, romanized: svanetis samtavro) was a small principality (samtavro) in the Svaneti region of the Greater Caucasus mountains that emerged following the breakup of the Kingdom of Georgia in the late 15th century. It was ruled successively by the houses of Gelovani and Dadeshkeliani, and was annexed to the Russian Empire in 1858.

Protectorate of the Western Regions.headline: Protektorat Zahodnih pokrajin
paragraphs: Protektorat Zahodnih pokrajin (poenostavljeno kitajsko: 西域都护府; tradicionalno kitajsko: 西域都護府), cesarska uprava v Zahodnih pokrajinah, je s presledki deloval pod kitajsko dinastijo Han in njenimi naslednicami od leta 59 ali 60 pr. n. št. do konca obdobja šestnajstih kraljestev leta 439 n. št. Zahodne pokrajine so območja zahodno od prelaza Jumen, zlasti Tarimska kotlina na jugu Šinjianga. Turško govoreča ljudstva so ta območja pozneje imenovala Altišahr (južni Šinjiang brez Džungarije). Izraz »zahodne pokrajine« so Kitajci uporabljali tudi širše za Srednjo Azijo.

Protektorat je bil prva neposredna oblast kitajske vlade na tem območju. Sestavljale so ga različne vazalne države in hanske garnizije pod oblastjo generalnega protektorja Zahodnih pokrajin, ki ga je imenoval hanski dvor.
notes: Izpuščena sta zapisa v pinjinu in po Wade-Gilesu.

source.title: Protectorate of the Western Regions
paragraphs: The Protectorate of the Western Regions (simplified Chinese: 西域都护府; traditional Chinese: 西域都護府; pinyin: Xīyù Dūhù Fǔ; Wade–Giles: Hsi1-yü4 Tu1-hu4 Fu3) was an imperial administration (a protectorate) situated in the Western Regions administered by Han dynasty China and its successors on and off from 59 or 60 BCE until the end of the Sixteen Kingdoms period in 439 AD. The "Western Regions" refers to areas west of Yumen Pass, especially the Tarim Basin in southern Xinjiang. These areas would later be termed Altishahr (southern Xinjiang, excluding Dzungaria) by Turkic-speaking peoples. The term "western regions" was also used by the Chinese more generally to refer to Central Asia.

The protectorate was the first direct rule by a Chinese government of the area. It consisted of various vassal states and Han garrisons placed under the authority of a protector-general of the Western Regions, who was appointed by the Han court.

Provisional Priamurye Government.headline: Začasna priamurska vlada
paragraphs: Začasna priamurska vlada (rusko: Приамурский земский край) je obstajala v Priamurju na ruskem Daljnem vzhodu od 27. maja 1921 do 16. junija 1923. Bila je zadnja enklava Ruske države v ruski državljanski vojni.

source.title: Provisional Priamurye Government
paragraphs: The Provisional Priamurye Government or Provisional Priamur Government (Russian: Приамурский земский край) existed in the region of Priamurye of the Russian Far East between May 27, 1921 and June 16, 1923. It was the last Russian State enclave during the Russian Civil War.

Pyu city-states.headline: Mestne države Pju
paragraphs: Mestne države Pju (burmansko: ပျူ မြို့ပြ နိုင်ငံများ) so bile skupina mestnih držav, ki so obstajale od približno 2. stoletja pr. n. št. do sredine 11. stoletja na območju današnjega Gornjega Mjanmara. Ustanovili so jih tibetsko-burmansko govoreči naseljenci Pju, najzgodnejši prebivalci Burme, o katerih so ohranjeni zapisi, ko se je ljudstvo Pju iz Tibeta selilo v celinsko Jugovzhodno Azijo. Tisočletno obdobje, pogosto imenovano tisočletje Pju, je povezalo bronasto dobo z začetkom obdobja klasičnih držav, ko je konec 9. stoletja nastalo Pagansko kraljestvo.
notes: Izpuščena je izgovarjava (IPA).

source.title: Pyu city-states
paragraphs: The Pyu city-states (Burmese: ပျူ မြို့ပြ နိုင်ငံများ [pjù mjo̼.pjɑ̼ nàɪɴŋàɴ mjá]) were a group of city-states that existed from about the 2nd century BCE to the mid-11th century in present-day Upper Myanmar. These city-states were founded as part of the migration of the Pyu people from Tibet to Mainland Southeast Asia by the Tibeto-Burman-speaking Pyu settlers, the earliest inhabitants of Burma of whom records are extant. The thousand-year period, often referred to as the Pyu millennium, linked the Bronze Age to the beginning of the classical states period when the Pagan Kingdom emerged in the late 9th century.

Golkondski sultanat je bil zgodnjenovoveški sultanat na jugovzhodu Dekana, ki mu je vladala dinastija Kutb Šahi. Enega od petih dekanskih sultanatov je leta 1518 ustanovil Kuli Kutb Šah, šiitski musliman turkmenskega porekla. Sultanat je obsegal dele današnjih indijskih zveznih držav Andhra Pradeš in Telangana ter nekaj delov Odiše, Karnatake in Tamil Naduja.

Golkondski sultanat je bil v nenehnem sporu z Bidžapurjem in Ahmednagarjem, s katerima je v 17. stoletju mejil na zahodu in severozahodu. Leta 1636 je mogulski cesar Šah Džahan prisilil Kutb Šahije, da so priznali mogulsko nadoblast in redno plačevali davek. Dinastija se je končala leta 1687, v času vladanja sedmega sultana Abula Hasana Kutb Šaha, ko ga je mogulski cesar Aurangzeb aretiral in do smrti zaprl v Daulatabadu, Golkondo pa priključil Mogulskemu cesarstvu.

source.title: Golconda Sultanate
paragraphs: The Golconda Sultanate was an early modern sultanate located in the southeastern Deccan, ruled by the Qutb Shahi dynasty. One of the five Deccan sultanates, it was established in 1518 by Quli Qutb Shah, a Shi'a Muslim of Turkoman origin. The sultanate covered parts of the modern-day Indian states of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana and some parts of Odisha, Karnataka and Tamil Nadu.

The Golconda Sultanate was constantly in conflict with Bijapur and Ahmadnagar, which it shared borders with in the 17th century to the west and northwest. In 1636, Mughal emperor Shah Jahan forced the Qutb Shahis to recognise Mughal suzerainty and pay periodic tributes. The dynasty came to an end in 1687, during the reign of its seventh sultan Abul Hasan Qutb Shah, when the Mughal emperor Aurangzeb arrested and jailed Abul Hasan for the rest of his life in Daulatabad, incorporating Golconda into the Mughal empire.

Imperij Raštrakuta je bil zgodnjesrednjeveški indijski imperij, ki je med 6. in 10. stoletjem vladal velikemu delu Indijske podceline. Na vrhuncu so Raštrakute iz Manjakhete vladali obsežnemu imperiju, ki je segal od dvorečja Gangesa in Jamune na severu do Kanjakumarija na jugu, v plodnem obdobju političnega širjenja, arhitekturnih dosežkov in slovitih književnih del.

Najstarejši znani napis Raštrakut je bakrena darovnica iz 7. stoletja, ki opisuje njihovo vladavino iz Manapurja, mesta v osrednji ali zahodni Indiji. Druga vladajoča rodbina Raštrakut iz istega obdobja, ki jo omenjajo napisi, so bili kralji Ačalapurja in vladarji Kannaudža. Ačalpurski klan je bil fevdalni podložnik badamijskih Čalukj, v času vladanja Dantidurge pa je strmoglavil Čalukjo Kirtivarmana II. in zgradil imperij s središčem v pokrajini Kalaburagi v današnji Karnataki. Ta klan je postal znan kot Raštrakute iz Manjakhete, ki so se leta 753 povzpeli na oblast v južni Indiji.
notes: Izpuščena je izgovarjava (IPA).

source.title: Rashtrakuta Empire
paragraphs: The Rashtrakuta Empire (Kannada: [raːʂʈrɐkuːʈɐ]) was an early medieval Indian empire ruling large parts of the Indian subcontinent between the 6th and 10th centuries. At their peak the Rashtrakutas of Manyakheta ruled a vast empire stretching from the Ganges River and Yamuna River doab in the north to Kanyakumari in the south, a fruitful time of political expansion, architectural achievements and famous literary contributions.

The earliest known Rashtrakuta inscription is a 7th-century copper plate grant detailing their rule from Manapur, a city in Central or West India. Other ruling Rashtrakuta clans from the same period mentioned in inscriptions were the kings of Achalapur and the rulers of Kannauj. The Achalpur clan was a feudatory of the Badami Chalukyas, and during the rule of Dantidurga, it overthrew Chalukya Kirtivarman II and went on to build an empire with the Kalaburagi region in modern Karnataka as its base. This clan came to be known as the Rashtrakutas of Manyakheta, rising to power in South India in 753 AD.

Kraljestvo Rattanakosin, po letu 1855 znano tudi kot Kraljevina Siam, je bilo siamsko kraljestvo (na območju današnje Tajske) med letoma 1782 in 1932. Ustanovljeno je bilo leta 1782, ko so ustanovili Rattanakosin (Bangkok), ki je kot prestolnica Siama nadomestil mesto Thonburi.

source.title: Rattanakosin Kingdom (1782–1932)
paragraphs: The Rattanakosin Kingdom, also known as the Kingdom of Siam after 1855, refers to the Siamese kingdom (in modern-day Thailand) between 1782 and 1932. It was founded in 1782 with the establishment of Rattanakosin (Bangkok), which replaced the city of Thonburi as the capital of Siam.

Republika Afganistan (paštunsko: د افغانستان جمهوریت; dari: جمهوری افغانستان) je bila prva republika v Afganistanu. Pogosto jo imenujejo Daudova republika, saj jo je julija 1973 ustanovil general sardar Mohamed Daud kan iz dinastije Barakzaj (skupaj z visokimi barakzajskimi princi), ki je z državnim udarom odstavil svojega bratranca, kralja Mohameda Zahirja Šaha. Povod za udar je bila afganistanska ustava iz leta 1964, ki je večini članov kraljeve družine odvzela oblast v korist centralizacije pod Zahirjem Šahom in njegovimi potomci v imenu demokracije. Daud kan je bil znan po avtokraciji in prizadevanjih, da bi državo posodobil s pomočjo Sovjetske zveze, Združenih držav in drugih.
Tudi Republika Afganistan je imela v tem času enotno in centralizirano državno ureditev.
notes: Izpuščeni sta latinični transliteraciji paštunskega in darijskega imena.

source.title: Republic of Afghanistan (1973–1978)
paragraphs: The Republic of Afghanistan (Pashto: د افغانستان جمهوریت, Dǝ Afġānistān Jumhūriyat; Dari: جمهوری افغانستان, Jumhūrī-yi Afğānistān), was the first republic in Afghanistan. It is often called the Daoud Republic, as it was established in July 1973 by General Sardar Mohammad Daoud Khan of the Barakzai dynasty (alongside senior Barakzai princes) who deposed his cousin, King Mohammad Zahir Shah, in a coup d'état. The occasion for the coup was the 1964 Constitution of Afghanistan which took power from most members of the royal family in favour of centralization under Zahir Shah and his offspring under the tenet of democracy. Daoud Khan was known for his autocracy and attempts to modernize the country with help from both the Soviet Union and the United States, among others.
The Republic of Afghanistan was also under a unitary and centralised form of government during the time.

Revolution in the Kingdom of Poland.headline: Revolucija v Kraljevini Poljski
paragraphs: Velik del ruske revolucije leta 1905 se je odvil v ruskem delu razdeljene Poljske (v Kongresni Poljski oziroma Privislinskem kraju) in je trajal do leta 1907. To je bil največji val stavk in najširše emancipacijsko gibanje, kar jih je Poljska doživela do 1970. in 1980. let. Eden glavnih dogodkov tega obdobja je bila vstaja v Łódźu junija 1905. Ves ta čas je prihajalo do številnih manjših demonstracij in oboroženih spopadov med kmeti in delavci na eni ter oblastjo na drugi strani. Zahteve demonstrantov so vključevale izboljšanje delavskih življenjskih razmer in politične svoboščine, zlasti večjo avtonomijo Poljske. Zlasti leta 1905 je bila Poljska na robu nove vstaje, revolucije ali državljanske vojne. Nekateri poljski zgodovinarji dogodke tega obdobja štejejo celo za četrto poljsko vstajo proti Ruskemu imperiju.
notes: Napotitev »see Congress Poland and Privislinsky Krai« je vključena v stavek kot pojasnilo.

source.title: Revolution in the Kingdom of Poland
paragraphs: A major part of the Russian Revolution of 1905 took place in the Russian Partition of Poland and lasted until 1907 (see Congress Poland and Privislinsky Krai). It was the largest wave of strikes and widest emancipatory movement that Poland had ever seen until the 1970s and the 1980s. One of the major events of that period was the insurrection in Łódź in June 1905. Throughout that period, many smaller demonstrations and armed struggles between the peasants and workers on one side and the government on the other took place. The demands of the demonstrators included the improvement of the workers' living conditions, as well as political freedoms, particularly related to increased autonomy for Poland. Particularly in 1905, Poland was at the verge of a new uprising, revolution or civil war. Some Polish historians even consider the events of that period a fourth Polish uprising against the Russian Empire.

Samma dynasty.headline: Dinastija Samma
paragraphs: Dinastija Samma je bila srednjeveška sindška muslimanska dinastija s središčem v Sindu. Ustanovil jo je Unar bin Babinah leta 1351, ko je porazil Hamirja (zadnjega soomranskega emirja) in razglasil neodvisnost od Delhijskega sultanata. Samme so prevzeli naslov džam, ki je ustrezal sultanu. Prestolnica sultanata je bila v mestu Samanagar (današnja Thatta). V začetku 16. stoletja jih je osvojila dinastija Arghun. Dinastija je v Sindu pustila arhitekturni pečat, zlasti v nekropoli Makli.

source.title: Samma dynasty
paragraphs: The Samma dynasty was a medieval Sindhi Muslim dynasty based in Sindh. It was established by Unar bin Babinah in 1351 after defeating Hamir (the last Soomra Emir) and declaring independence from the Delhi Sultanate. The Sammas took the title of jam, the equivalent of sultan. The capital of the sultanate was in the city of Samanagar (modern-day Thatta). The Sammas were conquered in the early 16th century by the Arghun dynasty. The dynasty has left architectural mark in Sindh, most notably at the Makli Necropolis.

Satavahane (Sādavāhana ali Sātavāhana), v puranah imenovani tudi Andhre (tudi Andhra-bhṛtja ali Andhra-džatija), so bili starodavna indijska dinastija. Večina sodobnih raziskovalcev meni, da se je satavahanska vladavina začela konec 2. stoletja pr. n. št. in trajala do začetka 3. stoletja n. št., nekateri pa njen začetek na podlagi puran postavljajo že v 3. stoletje pr. n. št., česar arheološki dokazi ne potrjujejo. Satavahansko kraljestvo je obsegalo predvsem današnje zvezne države Andhra Pradeš, Telangana in Maharaštra. V različnih obdobjih je njihova oblast segala tudi v dele današnjega Gudžarata, Madhja Pradeša in Karnatake. Dinastija je imela v različnih obdobjih različne prestolnice, med njimi Pratišthano (Paithan) in Amaravati (Dharanikota).
notes: Izpuščena je transliteracija IAST.

source.title: Satavahana dynasty
paragraphs: The Satavahanas (Sādavāhana or Sātavāhana, IAST: Sātavāhana), also referred to as the Andhras (also Andhra-bhṛtyas or Andhra-jatiyas) in the Puranas, were an ancient Indian dynasty. Most modern scholars believe that the Satavahana rule began in the late 2nd century BCE and lasted until the early 3rd century CE, although some assign the beginning of their rule to as early as the 3rd century BCE based on the Puranas, but uncorroborated by archaeological evidence. The Satavahana kingdom mainly comprised the present-day Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, and Maharashtra. At different times, their rule extended to parts of modern Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, and Karnataka. The dynasty had different capital cities at different times, including Pratishthana (Paithan) and Amaravati (Dharanikota).

Vojna v Gorskem Karabahu leta 2020 ali druga vojna v Gorskem Karabahu je bila oborožen spopad leta 2020 na spornem območju Gorskega Karabaha in okoliških zasedenih ozemljih. Bila je velika zaostritev nerazrešenega spora o regiji, v katerega so vpleteni Azerbajdžan, Armenija in samooklicana armenska odcepljena država Arcah. Vojna je trajala 44 dni in se končala z azerbajdžansko zmago, poraz pa je v Armeniji sprožil protivladne proteste. Spopadi so se v regiji nadaljevali tudi po vojni, med njimi obsežni spopadi leta 2022.

Boji so se začeli zjutraj 27. septembra z azerbajdžansko ofenzivo vzdolž ločnice, vzpostavljene po prvi vojni v Gorskem Karabahu (1988–1994). Spopadi so bili posebej hudi v manj goratih okrajih južnega Gorskega Karabaha. Turčija je Azerbajdžanu zagotavljala vojaško podporo.

source.title: Second Nagorno-Karabakh War
paragraphs: The Second Nagorno-Karabakh War was an armed conflict in 2020 that took place in the disputed region of Nagorno-Karabakh and the surrounding occupied territories. It was a major escalation of an unresolved conflict over the region, involving Azerbaijan, Armenia and the self-declared Armenian breakaway state of Artsakh. The war lasted for 44 days and resulted in Azerbaijani victory, with the defeat igniting anti-government protests in Armenia. Post-war skirmishes continued in the region, including substantial clashes in 2022.

Fighting began on the morning of 27 September, with an Azerbaijani offensive along the line of contact established in the aftermath of the First Nagorno-Karabakh War (1988–1994). Clashes were particularly intense in the less mountainous districts of southern Nagorno-Karabakh. Turkey provided military support to Azerbaijan.

Sena Dynasty.headline: Dinastija Sena
paragraphs: Dinastija Sena ali Seni so bili hindujska dinastija, ki je nasledila imperij Pala in je v zgodnjem srednjem veku, od 11. do 13. stoletja, iz Bengala vladala velikemu delu vzhodne Indijske podceline.

source.title: Sena dynasty
paragraphs: The Sena dynasty, or the Senas, were a Hindu dynasty that succeeded the Pala Empire and ruled much of the eastern region of the Indian subcontinent from Bengal, during the early medieval period, through the 11th and 13th centuries.

Dinastija Šišunaga (IAST: Śaiśunāga, dobesedno »Šišunagova«) je bila morda druga vladajoča dinastija Magadhe. Po budističnem besedilu Mahavamsa je bila druga vladajoča dinastija Magadhe in je nasledila Nagadašako iz dinastije Harjanka. Hindujske purane navajajo drugačen seznam kraljev dinastije Šišunaga z drugačno kronologijo, džainska besedila pa te dinastije ne omenjajo.

source.title: Shaishunaga dynasty
paragraphs: The Shaishunaga dynasty (IAST: Śaiśunāga, literally "of Shishunaga") was possibly the second ruling dynasty of Magadha. According to the Buddhist text Mahavamsa, this dynasty was the second ruling dynasty of Magadha, succeeding Nagadashaka of the Haryanka dynasty. The Hindu Puranas have given a different list with different chronology of the Shaishunaga dynasty kings, whereas Jain texts do not mention this dynasty.

Shan States.headline: Šanske države
paragraphs: Šanske države so bile skupina šanskih (tajskih) kneževin, imenovanih möng, katerih vladarji so nosili naslov saopha (sawbwa). Izraz »Šanske države« so prvič uporabili med britansko vladavino v Burmi kot geopolitično oznako za nekatera avtonomna območja Burme, podobna kneževskim državam Britanske Indije. Izraza »siamske Šanske države« in »kitajske Šanske države« sta označevala tajske kneževine na severu Tajske in na jugu Junana, ki so namesto tega prišle pod nadoblast Kraljevine Siam oziroma dinastije Čing.

source.title: Shan States
paragraphs: The Shan States were a collection of Shan (Tai) principalities called möng whose rulers bore the title saopha (sawbwa). The term "Shan States" was first used during the British rule in Burma as a geopolitical designation for certain autonomous areas of Burma, analogous to the princely states of British India. The terms "Siamese Shan States" and "Chinese Shan States" were also used to refer to the Tai principalities in northern Thailand and southern Yunnan, which instead came under the suzerainty of the Kingdom of Siam or Qing dynasty.

Širvan (perzijsko: شروان ali شیروان; azerbajdžansko in tatsko: Şirvan) je zgodovinska iranska pokrajina na vzhodnem Kavkazu, kot je bila znana v predislamskem sasanidskem in zgodnjem islamskem obdobju. Danes je pokrajina industrijsko in kmetijsko razvit del Republike Azerbajdžan med zahodno obalo Kaspijskega jezera in reko Kuro s središčem na Širvanski ravnini.
notes: Izpuščeni so latinični zapisi klasične in iranske perzijske oblike imena; perzijska pisava ostaja.

source.title: Shirvan
paragraphs: Shirvan (from Classical Persian شروان Shirwān or شیروان Shīrwān [Iranian Persian: شروان Shervân or شیروان Shirvân]; Azerbaijani: Şirvan; Tat: Şirvan) is a historical Iranian region in the eastern Caucasus, as known both during the pre-Islamic Sasanian Era and the early Islamic period. Today, the region is an industrially and agriculturally developed part of the Republic of Azerbaijan that stretches between the western shores of the Caspian Sea and the Kura River, centered on the Shirvan Plain.

Imperij Šunga je bil vladajoča tvorba s središčem v Magadhi, ki je približno od leta 187 do 75 pr. n. št. nadzorovala večino severne Indijske podceline. Dinastijo je ustanovil Pušjamitra, ko je Maurjam odvzel prestol Magadhe. Prestolnica imperija je bila Pataliputra, poznejši cesarji, denimo Bhagabhadra, pa so imeli dvor tudi v Besnagarju (današnji Vidiši) v vzhodni Malvi. Dinastija se je v šungovsko-grški vojni tudi uspešno bojevala z Grki in se jim uprla.

Pušjamitra je vladal 36 let, nasledil pa ga je sin Agnimitra. Šungovskih vladarjev je bilo deset. Po smrti Agnimitre, drugega kralja dinastije, pa je imperij hitro razpadel: napisi in kovanci kažejo, da je velik del severne in osrednje Indije sestavljalo veliko majhnih kraljestev in mestnih držav, neodvisnih od šungovske prevlade. Dinastija je znana po številnih vojnah s tujimi in domačimi silami. Bojevala se je s Kalingo, dinastijo Satavahana, Indo-grškim kraljestvom in morda s Pančalami in Mitrami iz Mathure.
notes: Izpuščena je transliteracija IAST.

source.title: Shunga Empire
paragraphs: The Shunga Empire (IAST: Śuṅga) was a ruling entity centred around Magadha and controlled most of the northern Indian subcontinent from around 187 to 75 BCE. The dynasty was established by Pushyamitra, after taking the throne of Magadha from the Mauryas. The Shunga empire's capital was Pataliputra, but later emperors such as Bhagabhadra also held court at Besnagar (modern Vidisha) in eastern Malwa. This dynasty is also responsible for successfully fighting and resisting the Greeks in Shunga–Greek War.

Pushyamitra ruled for 36 years and was succeeded by his son Agnimitra. There were ten Shunga rulers. However, after the death of Agnimitra, the second king of the dynasty, the empire rapidly disintegrated: inscriptions and coins indicate that much of northern and central India consisted of small kingdoms and city-states that were independent of any Shunga hegemony. The dynasty is noted for its numerous wars with both foreign and indigenous powers. They fought the Kalinga, the Satavahana dynasty, the Indo-Greek kingdom and possibly the Panchalas and Mitras of Mathura.

Siege of Bukhara.headline: Obleganje Buhare
paragraphs: Obleganje Buhare je potekalo februarja 1220 med mongolsko invazijo na Horezmijsko cesarstvo. Džingis-kan, vladar Mongolskega cesarstva, je sprožil napad iz več smeri na Horezmijsko cesarstvo, ki mu je vladal šah Mohamed II. Medtem ko je šah nameraval večja mesta braniti vsako posebej, so Mongoli oblegali obmejno mesto Otrar in prodrli globlje v Horezm.

Buhara je bila pomembno trgovsko in kulturno središče Horezmijskega cesarstva, vendar je ležala daleč od meje z Mongolskim cesarstvom, zato je šah za njeno obrambo namenil manj kot 20.000 vojakov. Mongolska vojska, ki je po ocenah štela od 30.000 do 50.000 mož in ji je poveljeval sam Džingis-kan, je prečkala puščavo Kizilkum, ki so jo dotlej imeli za neprehodno za velike vojske. Branilce Buhare je to presenetilo in po neuspelem izpadu se je zunanje mesto v treh dneh, 10. februarja, predalo. Horezmijski zvestobniki so citadelo branili še manj kot dva tedna, nato pa so jo prebili in zavzeli.

source.title: Siege of Bukhara
paragraphs: The siege of Bukhara took place in February 1220, during the Mongol invasion of the Khwarazmian Empire. Genghis Khan, ruler of the Mongol Empire, had launched a multi-pronged assault on the Khwarazmian Empire ruled by Shah Muhammad II. While the Shah planned to defend his major cities individually, the Mongols laid siege to the border town of Otrar, and struck further into Khwarazmia.

The city of Bukhara was a major centre of trade and culture in the Khwarazmian Empire, but was located far from the border with the Mongol Empire, and so the Shah had allocated fewer than 20,000 soldiers to defend it. A Mongol force, estimated to number between 30,000 and 50,000 men and commanded by Genghis himself, traversed the Kyzylkum Desert, previously considered impassable for large armies. Bukhara's defenders were caught by surprise and, after a failed sortie, the outer city surrendered within three days on 10 February. Khwarazmian loyalists continued to defend the citadel for less than two weeks, before it was breached and taken.

Siege of Petropavlovsk.headline: Obleganje Petropavlovska
paragraphs: Med obleganjem Petropavlovska, vojaško operacijo na pacifiškem bojišču krimske vojne, so britanske in francoske pomorske sile neuspešno poskušale zavzeti rusko pristanišče Petropavlovsk na polotoku Kamčatka. Ruske izgube ocenjujejo na 115 ubitih in hudo ranjenih vojakov in mornarjev, Britanci so imeli 105 žrtev, Francozi pa 104 (po uradnih ocenah zaveznikov).

source.title: Siege of Petropavlovsk
paragraphs: The Siege of Petropavlovsk was a military operation in the Pacific theatre of the Crimean War in which British and French naval forces unsuccessfully attempted to capture the Russian port of Petropavlovsk on the Kamchatka peninsula. The Russian casualties are estimated at 115 soldiers and sailors killed and seriously wounded, whilst the British suffered 105 casualties and the French 104 (by official estimates of the Allies).

Siege of the Sogdian Rock.headline: Obleganje Sogdijske skale
paragraphs: Sogdijsko skalo ali Ariamazovo skalo, trdnjavo severno od Baktrije v Sogdijani (blizu Samarkanda), ki ji je vladal Arimaz, so sile Aleksandra Velikega zgodaj spomladi leta 327 pr. n. št. zavzele med osvajanjem Ahemenidskega cesarstva.

source.title: Siege of the Sogdian Rock
paragraphs: The Sogdian Rock or Rock of Ariamazes, a fortress located north of Bactria in Sogdiana (near Samarkand), ruled by Arimazes, was captured by the forces of Alexander the Great in the early spring of 327 BC as part of his conquest of the Achaemenid Empire.

Vojna v Južni Osetiji 1991–1992 (znana tudi kot prva južnoosetijska vojna) se je bila med gruzijskimi vladnimi silami in etničnimi gruzijskimi milicami na eni strani ter silami južnoosetijskih separatistov in Rusijo na drugi. Končala se je s sporazumom iz Dagomisa, podpisanim 24. junija 1992, ki je vzpostavil skupne mirovne sile, Južna Osetija pa je ostala razdeljena med tekmujoči oblasti.

source.title: South Ossetia war (1991–1992)
paragraphs: The 1991–1992 South Ossetia War (also known as the First South Ossetia War) was fought between Georgian government forces and ethnic Georgian militias on one side and the forces of South Ossetian separatists and Russia on the other. The war ended with a Dagomys Agreement, signed on 24 June 1992, which established a joint peacekeeping force and left South Ossetia divided between the rival authorities.

Južni Han (kitajsko: 南漢; 917–971), uradno Han (kitajsko: 漢), sprva Jue (kitajsko: 越), je bil dinastična država Kitajske in eno od desetih kraljestev iz obdobja petih dinastij in desetih kraljestev. Ležal je na južni obali Kitajske in nadzoroval današnji Guangdong in Guangši. Dinastija je močno razširila svojo prestolnico Šingvang Fu (kitajsko: 興王府; današnji Guangdžov). Neuspešno je poskušala priključiti avtonomno tvorbo Džinghaj, ki so jo nadzorovali Vietnamci.
notes: Izpuščeni so zapisi v pinjinu in jutpingu.

source.title: Southern Han
paragraphs: Southern Han (Chinese: 南漢; pinyin: Nán Hàn; Jyutping: Naam4 Hon3; 917–971), officially Han (Chinese: 漢; Jyutping: Hon3), originally Yue (Chinese: 越; Jyutping: Jyut6), was a dynastic state of China and one of the Ten Kingdoms that existed during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period. It was located on China's southern coast, controlling modern Guangdong and Guangxi. The dynasty greatly expanded its capital Xingwang Fu (Chinese: 興王府; pinyin: Xìngwáng Fǔ; Jyutping: Hing1 Wong4 Fu2, present-day Guangzhou). It attempted but failed to annex the autonomous polity of Jinghai, which was controlled by the Vietnamese.

Southern Ming.headline: Južni Ming
paragraphs: Južni Ming, v zgodovinopisju znan tudi kot Pozni Ming, uradno Veliki Ming, je bil cesarska dinastija Kitajske in vrsta okrnjenih držav dinastije Ming, ki so nastale po incidentu Džjašen leta 1644. Kmečki uporniki pod vodstvom Li Dzičenga, ki je ustanovil kratkotrajno dinastijo Šun, so zavzeli Peking, cesar Čongdžen pa si je vzel življenje. Mingovski general Vu Sangui je nato vrata prelaza Šanhaj na vzhodnem delu Kitajskega zidu odprl čingovskim praporom, v upanju, da bo z njihovo pomočjo uničil sile Šuna. Mingovski zvestobniki so pobegnili v Nanking, kjer so Džu Jousonga ustoličili za cesarja Hongguanga, s čimer se je začel Južni Ming. Nankinški režim je trajal do leta 1645, ko so čingovske sile zavzele Nanking. Džu je pobegnil, preden je mesto padlo, vendar so ga kmalu zatem ujeli in usmrtili.
